visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short hair and glasses, wearing a white professional shirt, is seated in a modern clinic office. She speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and hand gestures. The background includes a desk with professional equipment, a lamp, and several skincare product bottles on a shelf. Lighting is bright and even. (2) The visual sequence continues with subtle camera angle shifts as the woman uses her hands to mimic the process of fat grafting and ultrasound treatment. Large text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear periodically to emphasize her speech. (3) The scene cuts to a clean graphic contact card displaying the clinic's logo, social media ID, phone number, and branch addresses in Taipei and New Taipei City, over a minimalist grey and white background.
